name: Blade x Bullet - Kinrin no Soleil
source:
Valkyrie, the ultimate divine spirit weapon. Anyone who obtains its power can overcome the military of an entire nation. Deep in the North lies the closed city of Eljudnir, upon which many girls gather with varying aspirations. The last person left standing would be able to obtain its power.

The resurrected Yagi met a girl who called herself Hela, the goddess of underworld. She told him that he possessed the spirit of the malicious god Loki, and informed him that, together with the black valkyrie Reginleiv, he was to hunt down those who sought the powers of the valkyrie.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
瓦尔基里，终极神灵武器。任何人获得了它的力量，就可以战胜整个国家的军队。北方深处有一座封闭的城市埃尔朱德尼尔，许多女孩聚集在那里，怀揣着不同的愿望。最后留下来的人，就能获得它的力量。

复活的八木遇见了一位自称冥界女神海拉的少女。她告诉他，他拥有恶神洛基的灵魂，并告诉他，他将与黑色女武神雷金莱夫一起追捕那些寻求女武神力量的人。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
